name: Wacom drawing tablets and pen displays
summary: Wacom pen tablets and pen displays. Without Wacom's driver the pen moves the pointer like a mouse, but pressure, tilt and the shortcut buttons do nothing.

linux.notes: Linux has Wacom support built in (the wacom kernel driver and libwacom). GNOME and KDE have tablet settings for the pen and buttons.

darwin.notes: Install Wacom's driver, then allow it in System Settings > Privacy & Security under Accessibility (and Input Monitoring if asked). No security changes are needed.

steps.title: Download the Wacom driver
steps.explain: Download the driver for your tablet model and macOS version, and install it.

steps.title: Allow the driver and replug the tablet
steps.explain: When macOS asks, allow the Wacom driver in System Settings > Privacy & Security. Then unplug the tablet, plug it back in and press "Check again".

win32.notes: Install Wacom's driver for pressure, tilt and the shortcut buttons.

steps.title: Download the Wacom driver
steps.explain: Download the driver for your tablet model and Windows, and install it.

steps.title: Replug the tablet
steps.explain: Unplug the tablet, plug it back in and press "Check again".
